defaults.D1: seg_id uses meeting, source channel, and source start/end milliseconds; split parts append _p<part number>; source nite:id is preserved in source_da_id.
defaults.D10: Project-selected 51 train, 12 validation, and 12 test meetings; stratify by meeting-series prefix with deterministic SHA-256 ordering and seed icsi-mrda-split-v1; assign five meeting-grouped folds over train and validation.
defaults.D11: Context units are dialogue-act rows; default documented grid is k in {0,1,3,5}; support left-only and symmetric left/right windows; mark the target with [T] and [/T].
defaults.D12: Order rows by source start, source end, agent, element ordinal, and part index; times compare numerically and agent compares by Unicode code point.
defaults.D13: Keep every word in the dialogue-act range, including quoted material and quote tokens.
defaults.D14: Benchmark one response per proposal against all responder chains' first segments; only ok and no_pair records are gold; malformed and ambiguous records are excluded.
defaults.D15: Keep parser/data-resolution problems in quality_flags; keep annotation-based non-speech and legitimate empty rows separate from errors.
defaults.D16: Use deterministic UTF-8/LF output, stable ordering and explicit SHA-256 fingerprints; omit build timestamps, commits, hostnames, and machine paths from release files.
defaults.D2: LABELS is (cs, co, aa, bk, ar, cc, other); aap maps to aa and arp maps to ar.
defaults.D3: Preserve all mapped target tags in canonical LABELS order; choose the primary multi-target label by cc > co > cs > ar > aa > bk.
defaults.D4: Bare b maps to other in the primary label; label_bk_merged maps bare b to bk.
defaults.D5: Keep every row; z/x tags set is_nonspeech; legitimately empty text sets is_empty; error-class rows are not eligible for release; formatter defaults to dropping flagged context units.
defaults.D6: Store general_tags and disruption_markers for analysis only; never include them in model input.
defaults.D7: Support raw, relative, and window_letters speaker modes; default context speaker mode is window_letters.
defaults.D8: Store all responder chains; derive the single-response benchmark policy through D14.
defaults.D9: Keep disfluencies, fillers, fragments, and original case as present in source text.
